notes.title: BiggerMap,New Explosions,Better Exp
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42322067/12d99f221e593cd276c6819dee71c03fb9c7b88c.png[/img]
BigerMap update now available with exciting new features!
Explore a larger game map with new terrain changes
New weapons added, including guided and unguided options, and Grad rocket launchers
Enjoy improved audio with dynamic engine sounds and changes to the Ukraine Girls' audio
Experience the thrill of big explosions with the new addition to the game
Guide your bullets with the new guiding system for even more strategic gameplay
Face a long line of targets heading towards Kiev for an exciting challenge
The BigerMap update provides many opportunities for fun and adventure in the game!

notes.title: Some Fixes and Addons
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42322067/10ae3acb853ef33c10742f19f55a494d76d34016.png[/img]
This game fix update includes several improvements and additions to enhance the gameplay experience. The update addresses a number of issues reported by players, with the following fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera would not return to normal view after destruction when in second camera mode.
[*] Added a new targeting aim system to make aiming more enjoyable and accurate.
[*] Added several new sounds to the game to create a more immersive and engaging gameplay experience.
[*] Changed the range of Putin's radars, which will add a new level of strategy and gameplay depth, and make the game more challenging and exciting.
[/list]
Overall, this game fix update is designed to improve the gameplay experience, address player feedback, and enhance the overall quality of the game. The change in radar range specifically will reduce the likelihood of players being destroyed instantly upon entering a forbidden area, which can be frustrating, and make the game more balanced and fair.
